caption: This drawing depicts a rectangular, ornately decorated wooden panel divided vertically into two sections of equal width. The left section is colored blue, and the right section is colored red. Both sections are adorned with golden-colored, diamond-shaped frames placed vertically at the center, each containing a similar floral motif featuring a central orange-yellow flower with a red center, surrounded by green foliage. Golden circular studs outline the division between the two sections and are also seen bordering the diamond-shaped frames. Additional decorative details include a carved floral element at the top of both colored sections and scrolled woodwork at the bottom. The panel has a decorative, gold-embellished cornice at the top with an alternating pattern of ovals and dots, while the rest of the frame appears to be a light brown wood. The artwork is rendered with visible pencil and color strokes on a plain, off-white background.
title: Pulpit Panel
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
